blocks.text: Special theory ke mutabiq kisi cheez ka mass us ki speed ke saath badalta hai. Ruki hui halat mein naapa gaya mass rest mass mₒ kehlata hai; speed v se chalti dikhe to us ka mass barh kar m ho jata hai:
Mass barhne ka matlab hai ke tez speed par cheez ka inertia barh jata hai. Jaise jaise v, c ke qareeb aati hai, speed badalne ke liye zyada force chahiye hoti hai.

blocks.text_alt: Jab v → c, to v/c → 1, is liye √(1 − v²/c²) → 0

blocks.text: Infinite (be-hadd) mass ko accelerate karne ke liye infinite force chahiye. Aisi force mumkin nahi, is liye koi cheez khali space mein light ki speed c tak accelerate nahi ki ja sakti.

Rozmarra zindagi mein speeds light ki speed ke muqable mein bohat hi kam hain. Zameen ki Suraj ke gird speed bhi sirf 30 km s⁻¹ hai, jab ke light ki speed 300,000 km s⁻¹ hai. Isi liye aam halaat mein Newton ke laws theek kaam karte hain. Magar jab subatomic particles light ki speed ke qareeb chalte hain to relativistic effects bohat saaf nazar aate hain, aur experiments ke results Einstein ki equations ke baghair samjhe nahi ja sakte.

blocks.text: Aam speeds par (v/c bohat chhota) dono curves 1 ke qareeb hain, is liye effect mehsoos nahi hota. v = 0.8c par time aur mass 1.67 guna aur length 0.6 guna ho jati hai. v jaise jaise c ke qareeb jata hai, laal curve be-hadd oopar jata hai: isi liye koi material cheez light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakti.

blocks.prompt: Material particle ka light ki speed se chalna namumkin kyun hai? Ek electron 500 m lambi khali tube se 0.995c par guzarta hai; electron ko tube kitni lambi lagti hai? Ausatan 20 min jeene wala neutron 0.8c par chalta hai; zameen se dekhne par woh kitni der zinda rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jaise v, c ke qareeb aati hai, m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) be-hadd barhta hai, is liye speed thori si bhi barhane ke liye barhti hui force chahiye; c tak pohanchne ke liye be-hadd force aur energy chahiye. ℓ = 500 m × √(1 − 0.995²) = 500 × 0.0999 ≈ 50 m. t = 20 min/√(1 − 0.64) = 20/0.6 ≈ 33.3 min.

blocks.prompt: Ruki halat mein 100 m lamba spaceship observer ke paas se 0.99c par guzarta hai; observer kitni length naapta hai? Proton ka mass kis speed par teen guna hoga?

items: Special relativity inertial frames ki theory hai (accelerating frames: general relativity). Postulates: (1) physics ke laws har inertial frame mein ek jaise; (2) khali space mein light ki speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ har observer ke liye ek. Result: space aur time relative.

Simultaneity relative hai (light se khulne wale darwazon wali train). Time dilation t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) (11.1); motion ki direction mein length contraction ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²) (11.2); mass m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) (11.3), is liye koi material cheez c tak nahi pohanchti.
